title: Contract Profile v0.1.11
description: Body-owning Contract DOMAIN profile (GV-lean). v0.1.11 RESTORES the FULL contract module a2_contract_module_v_00_01_06 (85 $defs across §1–§14: enums, parties, clauses/provisions, key terms, obligations, lifecycle, signatures, relationships, risk/compliance, JP-specific 電子署名法/印紙税法/下請法, US-specific HIPAA/state, financial, operational, and the ContractDocument root) — the 49 substantive defs that an earlier build had DROPPED are back. Refs: RENAME (Party→ContractParty …), shared types $ref Grand Vault v0.0.10, SignatureNode via the Signature profile. The 22 defs that also exist in GV0.0.12 are byte-identical to v0.0.12, so Composed (GV v0.0.13 + this profile) still reproduces the old GV v0.0.12 def set (lossless gate: tools/composed_lossless_test.py); the other 63 are additions.

PartyRoleEnum.description: Role a party plays in a contract. Domain specialization of GV ActorRoleEnum.

PartyTypeEnum.description: Legal form of party. Includes Japanese corporate forms (株式会社, 合同会社, 合資会社, 合名会社, 一般社団法人, 公益社団法人) and US forms (C-Corp, S-Corp, LLC, LP, LLP).

ClauseTypeEnum.description: Standard taxonomy of contract clause categories.

ContractTypeEnum.description: Common contract types. Includes Japanese types (業務委託契約, 請負契約, 委任/準委任契約, 継続的売買契約, 労働契約) and US types (BAA for HIPAA, MPA).

PaymentTermEnum.description: Includes Japanese B2B conventions (月末締め翌月末払い, 月末締め翌々月末払い).

DisputeResolutionMethodEnum.description: Includes Japanese options: 民事調停 (civil mediation), 裁判上の和解 (court-supervised settlement).

DeliveryMethodEnum.description: Includes 内容証明郵便 (Japanese content-certified mail).

JurisdictionEnum.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, optionally with subdivision (e.g., 'US-CA', 'US-NY', 'US-DE', 'JP-13' for Tokyo).

PartyAddress.description: Postal address. Used for notices, service of process, and registered office.

jpAddressFormatted.description: Full address in Japanese format (都道府県市区町村番地建物名).

PartyIdentifier.description: Government-issued or registry identifier for a party.

ContractParty.description: A party to the contract. Extends GV Entity with contract-specific role and identity.

legalNameLocal.description: Name in local script (e.g., 株式会社○○).

legalNameKana.description: Furigana reading of the legal name (法人名フリガナ).

corporateNumber.description: Japanese corporate number (法人番号, 13 digits). Form-facing flat twin of identifiers[type=jp-corporate-number].

branchName.description: Branch / office executing the contract (支店・営業所名).

signatoryName.description: Signatory's name (署名者氏名／代表者氏名).

signatoryNameLocal.description: Signatory's name in local script (署名者氏名・現地語).

signatoryTitle.description: Signatory's title (署名者役職名). e.g., 'CEO', '代表取締役'.

signatoryEmail.description: Signatory's e-mail — e-signature routing destination (署名者メールアドレス).

signingDepartment.description: Department executing the contract (契約締結部署名／主管部課).

signingDepartmentLocal.description: Department name in local script (部署名・現地語).

sealType.description: Seal / signing method declared for this party (押印・電子署名タイプ).

x-a2-enum-descriptions.jitsuin: 実印（代表者印・登録印）
x-a2-enum-descriptions.sign-only: 署名のみ（記名押印なし）

ContractClause.description: A contract clause. Extends GV SemanticBlock with taxonomy, numbering, and legal-basis tagging.

paragraphs.description: The clause body as ordered paragraphs (the 第N条 content). Each renders with a derived "1 / 2 / 3" number.

Paragraph.description: A numbered paragraph inside a clause (the "1 / 2 / 3" level). Its ordinal is derived at render from position in Clause.paragraphs; not stored.

paragraphText.description: The paragraph prose. May contain {{token}} references to sibling properties (see document_render_model.md P3).

SubItem.description: A "(1) (2) (3)" sub-item inside a paragraph. Ordinal derived at render from position in Paragraph.items; not stored.

itemText.description: The sub-item prose. May contain {{token}} references to sibling properties.

recitalText.description: The preamble/whereas prose. May contain {{token}} references (e.g. {{parties.1.name}}, {{purpose}}).

ClauseLibraryEntry.description: Reusable standard clause maintained by the legal team.

EffectiveDate.description: Date the contract takes effect. Extends GV Value.

JurisdictionClause.description: Court of jurisdiction. Distinct from governing law.

jpVenue.description: e.g., '東京地方裁判所 (専属的合意管轄裁判所)'.

Consideration.description: Monetary or other consideration. Multiple Consideration nodes allowed.

jpConsumptionTax.description: Japan consumption tax handling. Note 適格請求書発行事業者 (qualified invoice issuer) under invoice system effective Oct 2023.

Obligation.description: A discrete obligation created by the contract.

ServiceLevel.description: SLA metric with target and remedy.

POLineItem.description: Line item on a PO or invoice schedule.

LifecycleEvent.description: An event in the contract lifecycle. Append-only audit log.

VersionLink.description: Chain of contract versions during negotiation.

InternalApproval.description: Internal approval before going to counterparty. Distinct from signature.

SignatoryBlock.description: Complete signature record for one party. Wraps GV BlockSignature with party reference, capacity, and ceremony evidence.

capacityToBind.description: e.g., 'as duly authorized officer', 'pursuant to board resolution of YYYY-MM-DD'.

SigningCeremonyEvidence.description: Evidence captured during the signing ceremony. Required for high-value contracts and disputes.

ConsentToESign.description: Explicit e-signature consent. Required under US ESIGN §101(c), UETA §5; expected under JP 電子署名法.

Notarization.description: Notarial attestation. Covers traditional and remote online notarization (RON).

Amendment.description: Formal amendment to a previously executed contract.

externalContentHash.description: SHA-256 of external content at incorporation — protects against silent changes.

moralRightsWaiver.description: Common in US, restricted in JP.

jpMoralRightsHandling.description: Japan-specific: 著作者人格権の不行使特約 since they cannot be waived.

DataProtectionProvision.description: Data protection terms. Covers GDPR-style DPA, CCPA/CPRA, JP個人情報保護法.

jpEnforceability.description: Note: under JP law, exclusions for 故意・重過失 and personal injury are unenforceable. Consumer caps limited by 消費者契約法.

usEnforceability.description: Note: under US law, consequential damages exclusion must be conspicuous (UCC §2-719); unconscionability doctrine may apply.

ComplianceProvision.description: Anti-bribery, sanctions, export control, antitrust obligations.

JPShitaukeProtection.description: Provisions required by 下請法 (Subcontract Act) when applicable.

appliesToTransaction.description: Whether 下請法 applies based on capital and transaction type.

paymentDeadlineDays.description: Must be within 60 days of receipt (下請法 §2-2).

prohibitedActsCompliance.description: Compliance with 11 prohibited acts (受領拒否, 下請代金の支払遅延, 下請代金の減額, etc.).

JPDenshiShomeiCompliance.description: Compliance with 電子署名法 (Electronic Signatures Act) §3 requirements for legal presumption of authenticity.

satisfiesArticle3.description: Whether the signature satisfies §3 (固有性 — uniqueness and sole control).

service.description: e.g., 'GMO電子印鑑Agree', 'クラウドサイン', 'in-house ML-DSA'.

JPRevenueStamp.description: 収入印紙 record. Required for certain paper contracts under 印紙税法; exempt for fully electronic.

USStateLawSpecific.description: US state-specific provisions (DE, NY, CA most common).

newYorkChoiceOfLaw.description: NY GOL §5-1401: NY law for ≥$250K transactions.

californiaNonCompeteBan.description: CA Bus. & Prof. §16600: non-competes generally void.

uetaState.description: Whether the state has adopted UETA (49 states + DC).

breachNotificationDays.description: HIPAA default: 60 days, often contracted shorter.

OperationalMetadata.description: Internal business metadata not visible in the rendered contract.

aiSummary.description: AI-generated summary. Must trace to AIAction node in GV for audit.

aiExtractedTerms.description: Key terms extracted by AI for search/reporting.

NoticeRecord.description: Formal notice given under the contract.

ContractDocument.description: Root of a contract document. Specializes GV Root. Required structural validation lives here.

controllingLanguage.description: BCP-47 tag of the version that controls interpretation.

ContractConsentReceipt.$comment: Contract-specific ConsentReceipt (ESIGN disclosure). Composes GV ConsentReceipt.
